competitorNotes: Libra listings pitch 'Libra birthday gift' and 'September October birthday' and show scales, constellations, and boho styles; nearly all are digital.
Dates appear as September 23 - October 22 or 23; this poster prints October 22.
Most single-sign Etsy results are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Minimalist glyph-only sign prints exist but are mostly A4/A5 printables; the common styles are constellations, gradient 'aura' circles, and illustrations.
Libra appears on Amazon mainly as scales-themed metal tin signs (from the shared 'zodiac sign poster wall art' search snippet).
Amazon zodiac titles spell out size plus 'unframed' and the room (bedroom, living room, office); 12-sign sets, canvases, and tin signs crowd the results.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. 'libra zodiac poster' is the sign-plus-product phrase in competitor titles and the query run; sign tags use the glyph, dates, and traits printed on this poster. Birth-month phrasing follows competitors' month-based birthday titles. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical, unframed prints from framed prints and digital downloads.
